author: OPTOBAT
body:
Hey everyone, OPTOBAT here, and I've been reading a lot of the media posts about people who have channels with Avicus videos on them and i thought of a plan that will hopefully spread motivation and popularity throughout Avicus forums and games;
I want YOUR feedback on whether i should post a discussion on the Top 10 Avicus YouTubers in terms of subscribers.
So, that means i will do some deep Avicus researching and find out the 10 most subscribed channels that have any Avicus videos on them.

Should i post one? Please reply your decision so i can make up my mind :)
